name: Unravel Carbon
long_description: Unravel Carbon is a leading sustainability data management platform, used in 48+ countries. It uses AI/ML to help enterprises transform any operational data into full carbon supply chain data, helping them measure, track and report on their sustainability performance. It is already serving some of the world’s largest companies and is backed by Sequoia and Y Combinator.
one_liner: Enterprise software for companies to track & reduce their carbon…

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Founder (exited), turned VC (Kauffman Fellow), turned ClimateTech founder (YCW22). Oxford MBA, INSEAD; based in Singapore.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: I'm a chemical engineer with over 20 years' experience in a number of areas, including in operations and design of hydrogen facilities. Since 2007, I've been focussed on climate change and sustainability - helping organisations estimate their emissions, determine their exposure to climate risk and develop climate change strategies. I've worked extensively in low-carbon energy, large-scale decarbonisation and in carbon markets and offsets.
